strNotes: Requires Phobos Framework 0.17.0+ and the Shipbreaker plugin. Includes wall processing, grabber, chute, paired residue collection and a 4 x 4 scrap reclaimer. New wall jobs produce identified residue; the reclaimer recovers steel/aluminium and retains rejects. Old jobs and unclassified residue keep their original meaning. Reclaimer Control Panel and phobosreclaimer commands open feed and controls; room atmosphere receives process heat. Native station stock, construction and maintenance included. No ejection or attached-hull cutting. Ordinary saves supported; in-game compatibility remains subject to testing. Translation catalogs use Framework language selection. Version 0.9.0 adds explicit automatic reclaimer feeding from processors or collector buffers, separate input/output pairs, saved receiving filters and phobosroute commands. Routing and processing require separate Start and pause after reload. Version 0.10.0 adds a 3 x 3 industrial console, local equipment Control Panels, grouped ship overview, search, attention and routing. Remote control requires a powered console on a player-owned host ship; docked neighbours remain separate. Requires Phobos Framework 0.16.0+. Version 0.11.0 adds ship-scoped room alarm observations, built-in reclaimer cooling probes and session-only stop evidence through the console and F3. Equipment names now follow the Phobos' maker/model convention; saved identifiers are unchanged. Version 0.11.1 adds opt-in processing, routing and panel-refresh measurements through Phobos Framework 0.15.0. Version 0.12.0 adds the F6 electric casting furnace, finite exterior radiator, captive gas receiver, protected hot-state saves, local/C1/F3 controls, native UI donors and original furnace artwork. Requires Framework 0.16.0+. First in-game evaluation remains with the owner. Version 0.13.0 adds the optional F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port: a sealed 1 x 1 mounting head beside the furnace for a complete underside radiator assembly. Existing exterior radiator installations and hot-state saves remain valid. Choose one cooling assembly; installation changes require cool, empty equipment. Version 0.14.0 also discovers registered Agriculture equipment through Framework providers and checked C1 commands. Version 0.14.0 adds reactor-inspired named cooling attachments, side-aware connection artwork, a rotating installation key and isolated native guarded switches, seven-segment artwork and bounded draft sliders. Requires Framework 0.17.0+. Existing cooling geometry, saved links and thermal rules are unchanged; gameplay review remains with the owner.
